description: This file defines a NotificationItem class representing notification data, and a NotificationProvider class managing notification state, including a list of notifications and methods to add and mark them as read.

classes.name: NotificationItem
classes.description: Represents a notification with id, title, body, timestamp, and read status, including a copyWith method to create modified copies.

classes.name: NotificationProvider
classes.description: A state management class extending ChangeNotifier, managing a list of NotificationItems, with methods to add notifications and mark all as read.

methods.name: NotificationItem.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a NotificationItem with required id, title, body, timestamp, and optional read status.

methods.name: NotificationItem.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the NotificationItem with optional updated read status.

methods.name: NotificationProvider.items getter
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of current notifications.

methods.name: NotificationProvider.unreadCount getter
methods.description: Returns the number of unread notifications.

methods.name: NotificationProvider.push
methods.description: Inserts a new notification at the beginning of the list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: NotificationProvider.markAllRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read and notifies listeners.
